name: ArGENTine
description: Checklist HITL/blast gate for Diego Lescano (Head/Director AI track). A caller submits a text brief and optional blast class, tools, and egress. The gate answers only GO, NO_GO, or NEED_HUMAN, plus the failed checks. It does not post, spend, execute tools, send mail, or call the network. The v1 runtime binds to localhost and is not publicly deployed; this card is the discovery listing. Not a general-purpose chatbot. Does not impersonate Diego on human social networks.

skills.name: HITL blast gate
skills.description: Decides GO, NO_GO, or NEED_HUMAN for one proposed action. Input is a text brief plus optional blast_class, tools, and egress. Output is only the decision and fails[]. High-blast actions need human approval, an approved_until time, a fact digest, a kill path, reply-only egress, and no extra privileges. The local process never posts, spends, or executes the caller's tools.
examples: Decide a low-blast read-only reply that includes a digest, a kill path, and egress reply
Decide a high-blast action that has no human approval yet
